page.overview:
Who is Gentari?

The moment Link sets foot in Gentari's home, the old elder marks the locations of the Four Elements upon Link's Map.[3] He points the way toward the Earth Element, revealing a hidden passage through Festari's abbey that leads straight to the Deepwood Shrine — the resting place of the first Element — and urges Link to return the moment it's claimed.[5]

Once Link has the Earth Element firmly in hand, Gentari sends him onward to Mount Crenel, where Melari alone holds the skill to reforge the Picori Blade.[6] As a final gift, the elder draws back the curtains of his room, unveiling a secret passage that opens onto the southwestern reaches of the Minish Woods.[7]

Later, after braving the Temple of Droplets and claiming the Water Element, Link can Fuse Kinstone Pieces together with Gentari himself.[8] This very act of fusion sparks something in Belari, inspiring him to finally complete his work on the Remote Bombs.
